protocol_adherence.value: End-expiratory PL values were reported in 191 of 200 patients at baseline, and 199 of 200 patients on protocol. At baseline, 57.1% of patients had a negative PL value, and fewer than half of patients (45.5%) had end-expiratory PL within the hypothesized protective range of ±2 cm H2O.

provenance.quote: End-expiratory PL values were reported in 191 of 200 patients at baseline, and 199 of 200 patients on protocol. At baseline, 57.1% of patients had a negative PL value, and fewer than half of patients (45.5%) had end-expiratory PL within the hypothesized protective range of ±2 cm H2O (Figure 4).

extraction_flags.overlap_evidence: Confirmed overlap with beitler_2019 (EPVent-2 primary report). This paper states: 'All patients enrolled in EPVent-2 (NCT01681225) were included' and 'In total, 200 patients were enrolled in EPVent-2 and included in this analysis' — the same 200 participants as the primary JAMA 2019 report, same registration number NCT01681225, same EPVent-2 Study Group. This record is the secondary reanalysis; beitler_2019 is the primary report.
unclear_items: design.countries: inferred from the EPVent-2 Study Group Members site list (US and Canadian centres); the paper does not state countries explicitly. The Soroka (Israel) author is the analysis centre, not a recruiting site.

population.additional_baseline: Table 1 reports baseline characteristics stratified by APACHE-II (low n=99 / high n=101), not by treatment arm or for the whole cohort; arm_label set null and stratum membership noted in quotes.

feasibility.n_placement_attempted / n_placement_successful: derived (200 attempted, 199 successful) from the statement that both groups had Pes/PL measured and that one patient's balloon could not be inserted; the paper does not print these totals.
outcomes: mortality denominators vary by timepoint (102/98 at day 28, 101/98 at day 60, 100/96 at 1 year) as reported in Figure 2; loss to follow-up not explained in this paper.
intervention.balloon_calibration: not reported in this reanalysis; details are in the primary report (beitler_2019) and online supplement, which were not provided.
citation.pmid: not printed in the provided text.
data_only_in_figure: cumulative distributions of ventilator-free and shock-free days (Figures 3 and 6)
end-expiratory and end-inspiratory PL over time by day (Figure 4)
extraction_flags.general_notes: This is the post hoc reanalysis of EPVent-2, not the primary trial report; all intervention/comparator procedures are quoted from the trial procedures summary herein. Mechanistic PL–mortality analyses (protective range ±2 cm H2O, absolute value of end-expiratory PL) are observational associations independent of treatment group, recorded as effect estimates on transpulmonary_pressure outcomes. Shock-free days coded under domain 'other' as the schema has no dedicated shock-free-days domain.
